Gen AI Junior Developer

Ramat Gan, Israel Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and talented Gen AI Junior Developer to join our growing AI team.

In this role, you will work on real enterprise AI products and solutions, including:

  • AI Agents
  • LLM integrations
  • Enterprise copilots
  • Document Intelligence systems
  • AI automation platforms

You will collaborate with experienced AI architects, product teams, and enterprise customers to build production-grade Generative AI solutions.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 1–2 years of software development experience
  • Experience with Python development
  • Basic understanding of Generative AI / LLM concepts
  • Experience working with APIs and backend services
  • Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity for learning new technologies
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-moving environment

Significant Advantage:

  • Experience with OpenAI / Claude / Gemini APIs
  • Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Experience with LangChain / AI orchestration frameworks
  • Understanding of enterprise systems (ERP / Insurance / Finance)
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflows

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on real enterprise AI solutions in production
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Generative AI technologies
  • Fast-growing and innovative environment
  • Direct impact on products, architecture, and customer solutions
  • Work alongside experienced AI professionals and enterprise customers
